name: Chao Ts’ai-chi
bio: Chao Ts’ai-chi is dated by Giles to the 15th century AD. Her poem here is a lover’s message.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: To Her Lover
poems.author: Chao Ts’ai-chi
poems.text:
The tide in the river beginning to rise,
Near the sad hour of parting, brings tears to our eyes;
Alas that these furlongs of willow-strings gay
Cannot hold fast the boat that will soon be away!
